text_block_list.text:
One day, Tosen Jordan received
an interview request.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, isn't my racing outfit
just totally the cutest thing ever~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Patent leather is totally undefeated, and the slit
in this skirt and the glitter are super stylish, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You're doing a photoshoot in your racing silks now?
Man, that really does look great on you."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, high praise coming from an active model!
All that hard work really paid off~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You were seriously agonizing over it, huh?
Jordan, you used your brain way more than you do for studying, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally! I just used up a lifetime's worth of brainpower!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Tosen Jordan,
it's about time for your interview!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey.
Alright then, I'm gonna nail it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: One more photo, please!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's this?
Seriously, you look totally like a model!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the photo came out wonderfully!
Your racing silks have such a brilliant flair to them!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Next, could I get a photo
of you running?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah, you mean when I'm running?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, I styled my bangs pretty tight,
so please leave it like this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh... U-Understood...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: So running photos are a no-go, huh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's certainly a modern girl.
How should I put it, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm so beat.
The interview's fi~nally over.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? But like, wouldn't it be the worst
if I messed up my bangs after styling them?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Plus, photos of me running would probably make me look super desperate and totally uncool, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's not what it is, is it?
You're terrible at covering things up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Look, it's just kind of gross.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "I totally love this racing outfit. Like I said before, I put a ton of thought into it."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm the one wearing it, right?
Like... it's just plain old me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
I don't really know how to put it into words, but still!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're freaking out way too much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You know that Racewear isn't something an Umamusume
can wear just by running around aimlessly, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's...

"Racewear is proof of your effort and results.
The moment you're awarded it is amazing in itself,
and something you should be proud of"... That's what I told her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Man, aren't you being way too hot-blooded?
That's kind of lame in its own way, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I'm the one who looks uncool for not even running, huh.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Um, Tosen Jordan-san!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wait... huh?!
A reporter?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I really want to photograph
you running, Jordan-san...!
There are definitely fans who want to see you run!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Watch me run...
choice_data_list: Let me show you how cool I am!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't put that kind of weird pressure on me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, since you went out of your way to come here?
Guess I gotta live up to that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely gonna show you my cool side.
Make sure you capture it properly, okay?

There was no longer any sign of cowardice in her.
Having poured her heart out, her face was that of
a true, born competitor who hated to lose.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
Of course looking uncool isn't okay!
I just said I didn't want to show that kind of side—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh.
Then isn't it obvious what you should do?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Uh. F-First off, we're filming, right?
Come on, let's run!

Catching the evening sun, the sparkling glitter trailed behind her in beams of light.
Not a single soul present dared to laugh at her run.
